text: WorxInvest is the parent company of SD Worx and holds 77.5% of it (November 2023); in June 2023 CVC Strategic Opportunities II became a minority shareholder, with WorxInvest remaining majority shareholder.
short: WorxInvest holds 77.5% of SD Worx; CVC Strategic Opportunities II is a minority shareholder.

source.name: SD Worx press release: Gimv welcomes WorxInvest as reference shareholder
source.quote: In June 2023 it announced CVC Strategic Opportunities II as a new partner and minority shareholder in SD Worx. WorxInvest currently owns 77.5% of SD Worx.

additionalSources.name: Flanders Investment & Trade: CVC invests in HR services provider SD Worx (reported by newspaper De Tijd)
additionalSources.quote: British private equity giant CVC has acquired a 22.5% stake in SD Worx, a leading HR services provider headquartered in Antwerp, Flanders.
